name: Stanford Golf Course
architects: George C. Thomas Jr. and William P. Bell (opened 1 January 1930); renovated by John Harbottle (2008); bunkers rebuilt and some holes changed (2018) (stanfordgolfcourse.com, Stanford Magazine)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m bare-earth elevation (3DEPElevation ImageServer exportImage, float32, NAD83 / UTM 10N EPSG:26910, 1 m pixels, world + 100 m); NAVD88 metres; requested 2026-10-24

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (relation 3570691, three parts, 1,198 x 1,674 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,536 m east-west (169 m each side), 2,048 m north-south (187 m each side, the 2,048 m limit).

scorecard_source: The club's printed scorecard (Golf ScoreCards Inc., printed 10/2019; 2020SC1.jpg in GitHub release stanford-data, supplied by the developer 2026-10-24); every row adds up to its printed totals. Par 70. Cardinal 6,742 73.7/138, Black 6,213 71.0/131, White 5,771 69.1/123 (men) and 74.2/133 (women), Blue 5,363 71.7/130 (forward set, women's par 71: holes 12 and 16 par 5, 13 par 4; not in scorecard.csv's par column). Handicap: the row printed under Black (OSM's handicap tags follow the White row on the back nine; not used). Built from the Black tees (closest to 6,300 yd; the card's Blue is the forward set).
attribution: Elevation: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program
notes: Phase 1 (2026-10-24): standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1): every penalty area red, OSM boundary is OB, range OB, pins by the game, trees from lidar, wind 2-10 mph (Bay Area; no Californian row in the defaults). Default tee Black (the card's Blue is the 5,363 yd forward set). The boundary relation has three parts: the main course, a strip holding hole 1's green and hole 2's tee (27 m across Fremont Road; joined by join_boundary_parts, the road strip stays out of bounds) and the driving range 98 m east (left out of the boundary in edits.json; out of bounds). Developer 2026-10-24: Junipero Serra Boulevard (the only highway=primary inside the boundary, ~520 m) is out of bounds (ob_highways); the practice area north of holes 2-3 stays in play (its greens are wrong greens); keep the oak in the 12th fairway.
